summary.motive: Create an isolated 1-on-1 matchup on the perimeter for an elite route-runner from the slot, using an underneath out route to pin the outside corner and clear the sideline.
summary.keyDefender: Star / Nickel Defensive Back (Inside Leverage Slot Defender)
summary.whyItWorks: The inside stem threatens the nickelback’s inside leverage before snapping outside; the outside receiver’s quick out prevents the cornerback from sinking under the fade.
summary.failureMode: Nickelback maintaining outside leverage off the line of scrimmage or Free Safety cheating over the slot fade instead of honoring the opposite post.

beats.title: 1. The Pre-Snap Slot Isolation & Stem
beats.text: From 2x2 spread, slot receiver H (DeVonta Smith) stems directly at the inside shoulder of the Star nickelback, forcing the defender to honor an inside route.

beats.title: 2. The Rub & Out-Route Pin
beats.text: Outside receiver X snaps on a 5-yard quick out to the boundary, occupying the left CB and clearing out the entire deep sideline corridor.

beats.title: 3. The High-Arcing Fade Release
beats.text: H bursts outside off his inside stem, stacking the nickelback along the boundary. QB drops a perfect high-trajectory rainbow toward the front pylon.

beats.title: 4. Toe-Tap Touchdown in the Corner
beats.text: H extends over his outside shoulder, snatches the ball over the trailing defender, and drags both feet cleanly in the back corner of the end zone for a 24-yard score.

relations.tell: Straight dropback by the QB from 2x2 formation with no mesh handoff action.
